items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: Perez and I would get together. He was living in the Chesterfield, and I'd walk around there with him and we'd go have breakfast and like that

ctx.x: Well, when do you get with Lester?
Now, Perez was across the street, and I was working with Ben. Perez was at the Spotlight, and I was with Ben.
